games.name: The Chosen One but i made it
games.desc:
Welcome to TCOBIMI! This is a reimagination of the game "The Chosen One" in which the player with most time gets to be the server admin, aka The Chosen One.

You can type !cmds to view all commands ingame, and you can use the "!help" for more information. There are various things to play and mess around with, including community made maps and complex custom commands!

New updates may contain various obscure bugs or glitches. It's heavily advised to report those to the group's forum. And beware of abusers... public servers are most likely very chaotic!

IMPORTANT: This game is not a modded or stolen version of "The Chosen One" by TomazDev, it's made from scratch and no assets from the original were stolen. Credits to TomazDev and a TON of music artists for their work!

Developed by Blacklight's Games

games.name: Rusty Plane
games.desc:
Rusty Plane is a chaotic, co-op survival game where everything will go wrong, and that’s the fun of it. You and up to 5 other players must keep a falling-apart plane in the sky by fixing holes, repairing lights and pipes, regaining control, refueling, and re-oxygenating the cabin, all while chaos unfolds around you. Choose from 19 unique classes, each with their own special abilities, and see how long you can survive the madness.

Inspired by My Rusty Submarine
Game is currently in a Public-Beta stage, meaning the game isn't fully finished, so expect small bugs.
This game gets updated almost everyday and bugs are always fixed within a short amount of time. You can report bugs/players or give suggestions using the games feedback system.
If this game causes the end of your friendship, it is not my fault, remember, it's just a game.
